concerns.text: FR-001 demands human‑annotated feasibility scores for **all 1000 prompts**, but FR‑009 only requires annotation for at least 200 prompts. The spec does not explain how the remaining 800 scores will be obtained, making it impossible to verify FR‑001 as written.

The plan assumes a balanced collection of conflicting and neutral prompts can be sourced from InstructPix2Pix shards, yet InstructPix2Pix provides only single‑step editing instructions and does not contain naturally occurring contradictory instructions. Without a concrete method to create or source the required conflicting prompts, the acceptance inputs for US‑1 and US‑2 are not guaranteed to be reachable.
